 The artificial intelligence trade is expanding beyond Nvidia Corp. , with memory stocks emerging as another major focus for leveraged ETF traders. Micron Technology's strong performance and growing interest in its leveraged products underscore how investors are targeting different layers of the AI supply chain. 
 Micron and its 2X leveraged ETF, Direxion Daily MU Bull 2X ETF , have been among this year's standout performers, according to Jake Behan , head of capital markets at Direxion . 
 "Micron and MUU was this year's highest flier, which is no surprise as the memory trade was the trade of the year," Behan told Benzinga .

 The growing importance of memory chips reflects the enormous computing and data requirements of AI infrastructure. As demand for high-bandwidth memory and advanced storage accelerates, companies supplying these critical components are attracting greater investor attention alongside traditional AI leaders such as Nvidia. 
 Direxion's experience also points to the enduring appeal of individual technology stocks among leveraged ETF traders. 
 "Historically, and still, Tesla and TSLL has been the largest leveraged single stock in the U.S.," Behan said, referring to the Direxion Daily TSLA Bull 2X ETF . 
 The contrast between Tesla's established popularity and Micron's emergence as a major performer illustrates how quickly trading interest can shift toward companies benefiting from new market catalysts. 
 Beyond the Nvidia Trade 
 The changing dynamics are also reflected in how investors approach AI exposure through ETFs. While products tracking broader semiconductor baskets offer diversified exposure, individual stocks can experience sharp moves tied to company-specific developments, creating opportunities for tactical traders.

 "At Direxion we offer the single stocks that traders are most excited to trade with leverage…as well as our flagship SOXL, offering 3X daily exposure to the ICE Semiconductor Index," Behan said, referring to the Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X ETF . 
 "There are varied approaches to this AI trade and while some traders prefer a broad basket, single names often have idiosyncratic volatility events that present attractive opportunities," he added. 
 Story Continues The next frontier could be AI model developers themselves. Direxion plans to launch the Anthropic-linked ANTO and ANTD ETFs, offering 2X daily bullish and bearish exposure to the company following its anticipated IPO. 
 Behan said high-growth companies operating at the cutting edge of technology tend to resonate with leveraged ETF traders. 
 "Names that are high growth and pushing the cutting edge tend to resonate, hence our excitement around ANT," he said. 
 For ETF investors, the expanding range of products suggests the AI trade is no longer confined to semiconductor giants. Memory manufacturers, chip designers and frontier AI developers are increasingly becoming distinct opportunities to express bullish or bearish views.

 Building Wealth Across More Than Just the Market 
 Building a resilient portfolio means thinking beyond a single asset or market trend. Economic cycles shift, sectors rise and fall, and no one investment performs well in every environment. That's why many investors look to diversify with platforms that provide access to real estate, fixed-income opportunities, precious metals, and even self-directed retirement accounts. By spreading exposure across multiple asset classes, it becomes easier to manage risk, capture steady returns, and create long-term wealth that isn't tied to the fortunes of just one company or industry. 
 EquityMultiple 
 For accredited investors looking beyond stocks and bonds, EquityMultiple provides access to vetted commercial real estate deals starting at $5,000 , with only ~5% of opportunities passing their due diligence process. 
 Arrived 
 Backed by Jeff Bezos, Arrived Homes makes real estate investing accessible with a low barrier to entry. Investors can buy fractional shares of single-family rentals and vacation homes starting with as little as $100 . This allows everyday investors to diversify into real estate, collect rental income, and build long-term wealth without needing to manage properties directly. 
 Bito 
 As AI coding tools take on more of the work traditionally done by developers, companies are facing new challenges around code quality, context and the rising cost of AI-powered development. Bito is building software designed to help AI coding agents better understand complex codebases while helping companies control AI development costs. Founded by former PubMatic executives, Bito has raised more than $10 million from institutional and individual investors and is now raising additional capital through a Wefunder offering, giving investors an opportunity to invest in a company targeting an emerging need within the rapidly expanding AI software market. 
 FarmTogether 
 Farmland has historically held its value through market volatility and delivered returns uncorrelated to stocks and bonds. For accredited investors, FarmTogether offers direct access to high-quality U.S. farmland starting at $15,000 — fully managed, with no landlord headaches. 
 Fundrise 
 Private real estate and private credit can add income and stability to a stock-heavy portfolio. Fundrise offers access to diversified private real estate and credit strategies through an easy-to-use platform, with professionally managed portfolios designed to generate passive income and long-term growth.
